data.long_meaning: Derived from the names Matilda and Madeline, Maddy is a feminine name with a rich history. Matilda comes from the Germanic elements maht 'might' and hild 'battle'. Madeline is derived from the Hebrew name Magdalene, meaning 'tower of strength'.

in_greek.name: Μαδή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μαδή στην ελληνική παράδοση σχετίζεται με τη χαρά και την ευτυχία. Προέρχεται από τις ρίζες που συνδέονται με τη δωρεά του Θεού και εκφράζει την πνευματική χαρά και την αναψυχή που προέρχεται από την πίστη.

data.spiritual_significance: Maddy's roots in the names Matilda and Madeline carry strong meanings of strength, power, and resilience. The name is also connected to the biblical figure Mary Magdalene, who was present at Jesus’ crucifixion, anointed his body with costly perfumes, and was the first person to whom Jesus appeared after his resurrection. As such, the name Maddy is also a reminder of the transformative power of faith and the grace of God.
